personal.title: Sr. Application Security Engineer & Red Team Operator

ul.li: 11+ years of experience in Application Security, Cloud Security, DevSecOps and Red Teaming.
Specialized in embedding security into CI/CD pipelines and automating security processes.
Proven expertise in threat modeling, penetration testing, and compliance (PCI-DSS, SOC2, SOC3).
Skilled in building AI-driven security tools and dashboards.
Strong collaborator with cross-functional teams to enhance the application security posture.
Deep experience in cloud security, including automation, monitoring, and compliance.

responsibilities.item: Embedded security in SSDLC using Jira, Confluence, GitHub.
Led threat modeling with STRIDE, Threat Dragon in Jira.
Set secure coding standards; integrated SAST in CI/CD.
Enabled secret scanning with GitHub Advanced Security.
Managed SCA with Whitesource for open-source, containers.
Automated IaC scans for Terraform using Checkov tool.
Ran web/API pentests with Burp Suite and Kali tools.
Automated compliance checks for PCI, SOC2, SOC3 needs.
Enforced AWS security: IAM, KMS, Security Groups, VPC.
Automated cloud monitoring with Config, Hub, GuardDuty.
Built Lambda for auto-remediation, tagging in AWS cloud.
Maintained audit-ready evidence with CloudTrail, S3.
Developed Python/Bash scripts for vuln, evidence mgmt.
Secured fintech apps, infra, data with AWS automation.
Evaluated AI (OpenAI/Gemini) for security workflows.
Advised on security best practices for AI adoption.
Ran a hackathon for Security Awareness Month.
Collaborated to design secure software solutions.
Assessed vulnerabilities in web, API, mobile, and cloud.
Enabled shift-left security with Jenkins, Spinnaker, Git.
Automated security testing in CI/CD for consistent checks.
Enforced security gates before production releases.
Managed SAST (Checkmarx) and SCA (Whitesource) in pipelines.
Integrated Dependency Track for open-source risk management.
Automated vuln management with Nexpose, Lambda, Python.
Monitored endpoints (Win, Mac, Linux, Docker) with Uptycs.
Built dashboards and alerts for security visibility.
Provided rapid vulnerability feedback to developers.
Ran monthly ConMon with Nexpose, Uptycs, AWS Config.
Stored scan results in S3 and integrated with Splunk.
Presented security evidence to stakeholders, auditors.
Supported FedRAMP cycles by meeting all requirements.
Acted as liaison with 3PAOs during FedRAMP audits.
